sections.title: Merre?
sections.content: *Merre?* means "which way?". Ask it with *van* or *mész* and answer with one of the three direction words. Put two statements together with *és* (and). Use words you know to say where a place is: *A bank a templom mellett van, jobbra.* (The bank is next to the church, on the right.) If the place is not far, add *közel van*.

sections.title: Ask and answer
rows: Balra megyünk, mert ott van a bank.
We go left because the bank is there.

items.english: It is straight on, next to the church.

items.spanish: Egyenesen megyünk, és jobbra van a bank.
items.english: We go straight on, and the bank is on the right.

items.spanish: Balra megyek, mert ott van a gyógyszertár.
items.english: I am going left because the chemist is there.

sections.content: *Hol?* asks for the place and *Merre?* asks for the direction. A good answer to *Merre?* is one of the three direction words, not *itt* or *ott*.
